sources.quote: A temporary deviation may cover at most 2000 pieces and at most 6 weeks.

findings.why: The request is for 3,500 BR-220 pieces over 10 weeks. That exceeds both the 2000-piece limit and the 6-week limit. The 100% hole inspection requirement is met, but it does not cure the overrun. The procedure only allows expediting the approved source or a deviation within these limits.

sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR in force. A temporary deviation therefore needs Stellantis approval before any shipment. The only deviation on record, DEV-2025-019, covers part HS-040, so nothing in force covers this request.
